tasks.short: Prepare daily customer transaction and earnings reports

steps.what: Retrieve actual daily transactions and account balances for the correct customer accounts and reporting cutoff
inputs: existing posted transaction ledger with account identifiers, timestamps and settlement status
actual account balances and reporting cutoff
outputs: checked daily account extract with explicit cutoff and posting status

steps.what: Reconcile daily account transactions and resolve flagged duplicates, reversals or incomplete postings
inputs: checked daily account extract with explicit cutoff and posting status
actual ledger control totals and transaction references
outputs: reconciled report dataset with unresolved exceptions clearly marked

steps.what: Calculate daily transaction and earnings totals using the approved accounting definitions
inputs: reconciled report dataset with unresolved exceptions clearly marked
approved treatment of fees, currencies, income and corrections
actual source values and approved conversion rates where required
outputs: checked account-level daily totals with calculation provenance

steps.what: Prepare each customer's complete report and exact delivery destination using the approved account template
inputs: checked account-level daily totals with calculation provenance
reconciled report dataset with unresolved exceptions clearly marked
existing verified account delivery preferences and destinations
outputs: complete customer report package with exact account-to-recipient mapping

steps.what: Approve the completed customer report package after checking totals, exceptions, account separation and exact destinations
inputs: complete customer report package with exact account-to-recipient mapping
actual ledger control totals and transaction references
existing verified account delivery preferences and destinations
outputs: approved final customer report package and exact recipients

steps.what: Send the exact approved report package to its approved customer destinations
inputs: approved final customer report package and exact recipients
outputs: delivered customer reports with actual delivery status

steps.what: Save the approved daily report package in the existing reporting archive
inputs: approved final customer report package and exact recipients

tasks.design: Configure the brokerage accounting and reporting platform {OPS_SYSTEM} to extract posted transactions, apply existing reconciliation and earnings rules, and populate the approved account-report template. The clerk resolves exceptions and approves the full report-to-recipient mapping before the separate delivery and archive actions; no language model is needed for financial arithmetic.
tasks.previous_blocker: Where daily report features are not configured, repeated extract setup, fixed calculations and report assembly can consume clerical effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing ledger reporting and deterministic reconciliation functions can reuse actual posted records and approved accounting definitions.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete postings, disputed corrections and deciding whether a report is ready to issue need an accountable person.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk recognises when a balanced total conceals an incorrect account, cutoff or recipient.

ambition.what: Review daily reporting exceptions with traceable account-level calculations.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for ledger access, reporting authority and privacy review

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: brokerage accounting platforms can report posted account transactions, apply configured financial calculations and generate account-level reports; exceptions and release still need review.

assumptions: The 100-hour allocation and remaining effort are provisional scenarios, not measured current brokerage operations or an industry baseline.

The actual ledger already contains account identifiers, timestamps, posting status and source references. Existing verified delivery preferences are maintained by the authorised account process; missing or changed destinations require verification rather than inference.
The organisation supplies approved earnings and reconciliation definitions; the clerk does not invent accounting treatment and no model makes investment judgements.
Native reporting features are configured first. If already in use, additional savings are zero; no historical spreadsheet or manual rekeying is asserted.
The clerk is authorised under local policy to approve routine completed account reports; required escalation remains for unresolved exceptions.
Delivery and same-platform archive actions take approximately no time today relative to report preparation. Their minimum schema allocations are fully retained, with no saving.
The saved reporting package is one reporting artefact; this workflow does not modify holdings or execute securities transactions.
unknowns: How much work concerns exceptions rather than routine assembly
Whether release requires another authorised role
research_questions: What routine reporting effort remains after using native account reports?
Which exceptions prevent a completed report from being approved?

already_counted.description: Check complete account reports, calculation support and exact destinations

incremental.description: Maintain report definitions, reconciliation rules and account-delivery mapping checks

approvals.approved_version: approved exact customer report package and account-to-recipient mapping; any edit returns to s5
approved final daily reporting package from s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 18.75 extract hours +10 routine reconciliation hours +16 fixed-calculation hours +14 assembly hours =58.75. Four upkeep hours give central net 54.75%; 9.75 additional hours resolving posting exceptions gives high 45%. Low zero if native reporting already covers these steps. This is scenario arithmetic, not a measured promise.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: account operations: maintain verified delivery preferences
reporting supervisor: define release and escalation authority
role.ambitious_version: A brokerage clerk who concentrates on exceptions and account correctness while the existing platform performs repeatable report preparation.
